answer: Physical Resource Exhaustion Registry: each agent identity must continuously hold a unique hardware-rooted timing channel whose clock drift is measured against a shared reference; operators register the drift signature, and any clone reusing it produces an identical echo that the registry rejects. Because drift depends on microscopic manufacturing variation, a single operator cannot fabricate distinct signatures at scale. The registry cross-checks signatures through a prism of independent reference nodes, and quarantines mismatches in a lagoon of revoked identities.
